entities.name: Abd El Gadir Salim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdel Gadir Salim was a Sudanese singer and bandleader of popular music from Sudan. He was one of the most well-known Sudanese singers in the West and performed around the world and recorded in countries such as the United Kingdom and France.
